crossRefs.note: However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself…
He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine, and will declare it to you.
We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ…

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: They didn’t know that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.
translations.bsb: They did not realize that Joseph understood them, since there was an interpreter between them.
translations.kjv: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.
translations.asv: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.
